title: Glowing Musical Note
description: A large, luminous treble clef and musical note float centrally, outlined in bright white and yellow light with soft glowing particles and drips. The note is superimposed over a background of colorful, pastel musical staves and scattered notes in a dreamy, watercolor style.
prompt: A luminous glowing treble clef and musical note made of soft white and golden light with sparkling particles and gentle drips, floating over a background of colorful pastel musical staves and floating notes, soft watercolor washes in dreamy hues of blue, yellow, pink and green, ethereal and magical atmosphere.
